conventions.climatological_elevation_proxy_method: climatological_elevation_proxy: constant-lapse hypsometric inversion at the city's robust median surface pressure and median temperature, P_ref=1013.25 hPa (ICAO)

sampling.method: deterministic stratified (city x month) per period via seeded per-row uniform draws

city_match.method: nearest reference city (haversine) within max_km, else GLOBAL_FALLBACK

global_fallback.note: Pooled robust statistics over ALL reference cities (pressure pooled in sea-level-equivalent space). Wide by construction: it mixes climates, so it is a coarser baseline than a city and is used only when no city is within the match radius.
